meta_description: Top Reasons to Book the Lovely Home: * Less than a mile from the Beach - Gulf View Heights Access* Community Pool, Grills, Covered Picnic Area, and Playground* Quiet Neighborhood, Fishable Lake, and Nature Trails* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attra
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book the Lovely Home: * Less than a mile from the Beach - Gulf View Heights Access* Community Pool, Grills, Covered Picnic Area, and Playground* Quiet Neighborhood, Fishable Lake, and Nature Trails* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults under age 25. No Exceptions. **We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs from November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to Sun Kissed, a stunning 3-bedroom, 2 bath home that sleeps 6 and is nestled in the serene Forest Lakes community, just a stone's throw away from the picturesque neighborhood lake and nature trails. Enjoy your morning coffee surrounded by tall pines from the large covered back patio and spend your days exploring 30A on the 4 included bikes. The Master has a king bed, and both guest bedrooms have queen beds. Come make lasting memories at Sun Kissed for years to come.*Please note this home is located within an HOA community. Guests are required to follow all HOA rules and regulations, carefully review the rental agreement in full, and observe all posted signage throughout the home to ensure a smooth and enjoyable stay**Two parking spots are available in the driveway, and no street parking is allowed. *Bed Setup:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom 1: Queen BedGuest Bedroom 2: Queen BedForest Lakes neighborhood has an idyllic setting overlooking a peaceful lake with thousands of acres of state forest bordering the community. Completely secluded and quiet, it's hard to believe Highway 30A is just down the road and offers quick access to all the amenities you could desire in this South Santa Rosa Beach location. The recently renovated community pools offer for a relaxing dip after a long day at the beach. Make memories on the fishable lake, that's catch and release, and there's also a lovely, covered picnic area with grills, as well as a playground for the kiddos. Blue Mountain Beach is just to the east, and the shops, entertainment, and dining venues of Gulf Place Town Center are a short drive to the west. Incredible white sand beaches are a few minutes down the road.Area Attractions:This is a fantastic location with Gulf Place Town Center only 1.5 miles to the West and Watercolor, Grayton Beach, Seaside, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach just minutes away to the East. Biking is a great activity to enjoy as the scenic bike path meanders along 30A. Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! You'll have an array of dining options to choose from! 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar-white sand and emerald-green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, and tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
